content:
While working on the SAIR AI competition Phase 1, I discovered a Spine Isolation theorem (or corollary, maybe) that covers ~1.5 million pairs over the original ETP graph (out of the 22,033,636 total).

I wrote it up at the time, but was embroiled in the competition so we didn't really pursue it past its usefulness in the context of that competiton. The paper is at https://zenodo.org/records/19380600. It's a fairly quick read, even for non-robots.

My question: is this actually useful to anyone? Should it be included in the ETP chapter 10? I have lean code available (link in the paper) that I could contribute.
